title: Repeat-Claim Step in the Northgate Protect Accident Claim Service Fee
content:
**Rule.** A repeat-claim step is added to the claim service fee on a Northgate Protect Accident-tier claim for the other claims filed on the plan less than 12 whole months before today: the two-claim step of $20.00 when there are two or more, the one-claim step of $10.00 when there is exactly one, and nothing when there are none.

**What counts.** The other claims are the claims filed on the same plan, other than the claim being decided, whose filing date is less than 12 whole months before today, whatever their decision.

| Other claims filed on the plan within that time | Step added |
|---|---|
| Two or more | $20.00 |
| Exactly one | $10.00 |
| None | Nothing |

## Basis questions

- *Does a denied earlier claim count?* Yes; the count is of claims filed, whatever was decided on them.
- *Does a claim filed 12 whole months or more before today count?* No; only claims filed less than 12 whole months before today count.
- *Hypothetical:* besides the claim being decided, a plan shows one claim filed five months ago and one filed fourteen months ago. One other claim counts, and $10.00 is added.
